After a little while someone else saw him, and said, “You also are one of them!” But Peter answered, “Man, I am not!”

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Nazareth
people.line: The hometown of Jesus in Galilee

translations.web: When he had gone out onto the porch, someone else saw him, and said to those who were there, “This man also was with Jesus of Nazareth.”
translations.bsb: When Peter had gone out to the gateway, another servant girl saw him and said to the people there, “This man was with Jesus of Nazareth.”
translations.kjv: And when he was gone out into the porch, another maid saw him, and said unto them that were there, This fellow was also with Jesus of Nazareth.
translations.asv: And when he was gone out into the porch, another maid saw him, and saith unto them that were there, This man also was with Jesus of Nazareth.
